name: Sticky Roller
hook: Roll up crumbs, then toys, then cars, then houses.
how: Roll a sticky ball around a toy town. Anything smaller than you sticks on and you grow, so bigger things become rollable, and smaller players too. Biggest ball when the time runs out wins.
controls: W to roll, A/D to steer, Space to dash, or a stick and a Dash button
uses: The biggest balls ever rolled, in cm.
The host's browser decides who gets each thing (first to touch it) and who rolls up whom; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
The host's browser starts each timed round and posts the sizes at the end.
Bots roll, grow and chase smaller balls until enough people join.
Every ball rolls for everyone at once, with the same things stuck on it.
ideas: Make it a kitchen with fruit, pans and fridges
Add a golden thing that doubles your size
Make the round 5 minutes and add skyscrapers
